w: Marked as Youth Day, various programs were presented by youths throughout the day. The youths of Goghavadar chapter pledged to refrain from Navratri garba, TV and movies.

Some youths of Gondal announced before Swamishri that they would daily come for darshan of Akshar Mandir. Swamishri was pleased and said, "There is one Premjibhai who comes here daily. Do you know him? He wears a black topee and white dhoti. For many years he follows a niyam - he comes for darshan everyday! He comes from town on a cycle and still wears a black coat and topee. Ever since I became a sadhu and came here, I have been seeing him. He comes for darshan every day. His niyam of daily darshan is unbroken. So you should remain firm in your niyam. God will be happy and you will get inner strength. He (Premjibhai) was firm so the niyam remained. You may think how can you remain firm? But you can!..." Someone added, "He is 90 years old and still does not take the support of a walking stick." "He never gets a fever and does not take any medicines... His health is fine," a youth added. Swamishri confidently substantiated, "... Even by following a small niyam (pledge) like coming to the mandir intensely pleases God and His holy sadhu. One is blessed with inner strength.
An Annakut had been arranged before Thakorji in the mandir. Swamishri performed the Shangar arti .

In the packed evening assembly, four sadhaks from London were given the parshad diksha by Swamishri. Yogen C. Patel was renamed as Svetketu Bhagat, Harikrishna M. Patel - Upmanyu Bhagat, Priyesh S. Patel - Kapil Bhagat and Vimal S. Patel - Vamdev Bhagat.
On the symbolic celebration of Swamishri's 80th birthday, senior devotees and sadhus offered garlands and bouquets. The kishores performed an enthralling Guru Bhakti dance.
A certificate of Guinness World Record 2000 for the Annakut of 1247 food items held in the mandir on 27 October, was presented to Swamishri.

During his blessings Swamishri said, " ... Through His wish and strength everything happens. All the honor and progress is due to Shriji Maharaj, Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj. We do not have the strength to do this work. When Shastriji Maharaj entrusted this task (as president of BAPS) I told him that it was too big for me. The reason being that I was young and inexperienced. Shastriji Maharaj replied, 'It is the work of Maharaj. Maharaj will do the work. All we have to do is to remember Him and do what he inspires. And the work will be done in that way. Therefore there is no need for you to worry. Put all your worries on Maharaj. You have my blessings that whatever work you do will be good and successful. You will get everyone's cooperation.' So by the blessings of Swami everything is being done. And the same blessings I got from Yogiji Maharaj. Through his blessings this work (of the Sanstha's program) is being done."
Summary of Swamishri's Satsang Tour Abroad 2000
Swamishri with Dignitaries and Honors Bestowed
Guinness Book of World Records honors Swamishri for consecrating a record 355 mandirs in 11 countries.
Swamishri's speech at the Millennium Peace Summit in the UN.
Meeting H.E. Kofi Annan, Secretary General of UN.
Meeting President Bill Clinton.
Meeting the President of Portugal and EEC, H.E. George Sampaiao.
Numerous Key to the City and Proclamations were presented.
Mandir Consecration Ceremonies
Swamishri consecrated six mandirs in the USA: Philadelphia, Birmingham, Miami (of murtis only), Clifton, Jersey City, Chicago (Hari mandir).
Re-consecration of six mandirs: Fall River, Augusta, Jackson, Washington DC, Dallas, Cleveland, Edison (Radha Krishna Dev). Total: 13 murti pratishthas.
Inaugurated Haveli in Chicago.
Performed foundation stone laying ceremony of five mandirs: Toronto, Houston, Tampa, Atlantic City, Detroit.
Ground-breaking ceremony of three mandirs: LA, Atlanta, Miami.
Fostering Satsang
Swamishri inspired children, teenagers, youths and seniors through Bal, Kishore and Yuva Shibirs and satsang.
Swamishri blessed the special programs at different Satsang centers: Bal Din, Kishore Din, Yuva Din, Volunteers' Day, Senior Citizens' Day.
Cultural and Social Services
Swamishri inspired many newcomers to quit addictions.
Successfully inspired a campaign to support the Narmada Dam Project by petitioning to the 'International Rivers Network' in Washington DC.
Blessed Medico- Spiritual Conferences.
Hundreds of public assemblies were held.
Hindu festivals were celebrated: Rath Yatra, Guru Purnima, Raksha Bandhan, Janmashtami, Jal Jilani, Sharad Purnima, Diwali, New Year's celebration.

Swamishri blessed everyone as he went to Akshar Deri. After having darshan Swamishri performed the New Year's mahapuja from 6.10 a.m. Thereafter he performed his morning puja and blessed the devotees, saying, "New Year's Jai Swaminarayan to everyone. Blessings to you all for the New Year. May you all engage yourself in bhajan and spiritual discourses. Maharaj will be happy upon you... When Yogiji Maharaj used to be here devotees from India and abroad would come for darshan and listen to spiritual discourses. They would wish to stay for one day but Yogiji Maharaj made them stay for five. The reason was to lessen their worldly desires. The great Sadhu has the desire to worship God and abide by moral rules and to inspire others likewise ..."
At 11.20 a.m., Swamishri and sadhus sang thal and offered annakut to Thakorji.

Swamishri inaugurated the new website on Swaminarayan Akshardham , www.akshardham.com, after his morning puja. Shri L.K.Advani came to see the Akshardham complex and thereafter received Swamishri’s blessings.

Guest Opinion : Shri L.K. Advani, President of Bharatiya Janata Party, expressed, “I can only say that those who have conceived it, and those who have executed it, and it’s not a few artists and architects, but tens of thousands of dedicated, devoted bhaktas of the Swaminarayan Sampraday – they all deserve kudos, they deserve plaudits for this achievement, which will always be remembered by everyone. It’s a great service that they have done to the cause of spirituality and religion, and it’s a great service that they have done to the motherland.”

st.t: Pramukh Swami Maharaj – Kartik Purnimã – Sunday 5th November 2006
w: The auspicious day of Dev Diwali traditionally celebrated in Bochasan, was marked by a special assembly in the Haveli in the presence of Pramukh Swami Maharaj with the beautiful backdrop of Bochasan Mandir. Viveksagar Swami explained the significance of the Dev Diwali period in great detail. Following this, awards were given to those kishores and kishoris who had achieved the highest academic success at GCSE, A-Level and degree. Swamishri in his blessings explained that such festivals become the pathway to Akshardham if we remember them in our last moments. Swamishri also mentioned that devotees from all over the world ‘desh deshthi’ have come to participate in today’s festival just as in the time of Bhagwan Swaminarayan. For the second time during Swamishri’s stay in London, he graced the devotees of UK and Europe with Sameep Darshan.
After Swamishri’s morning puja, Mr John Malcolm (who is writing a biography on Sir John Malcolm, the Governor of Bombay State who had met Bhagwan Swaminarayan) was honoured by Viveksagar Swami.

Swamishri also inaugurated new publications by Swaminarayan Aksharpith: Hinduism, An Introduction, Sanskrutinad, Smruti Toran (photo album of Yogiji Maharaj), Vachanamrut (MP3) and a small replica of Bhagwan Swaminarayan’s murti in Swaminarayan Akshardham, New Delhi.

At 6.10 p.m. Swamishri performed the rituals of chopda pujan ( pujan of accounts books of devotees) in front of the mandir. Thousands of devotees also participated in the rituals. Viveksagar Swami gave a discourse on the importance of chopda pujan and honoured Swamishri with a garland. Finally, Swamishri blessed the assembly and personally showered flowers and rice grains to sanctify the accounts books.

Today, while having darshan of Ghanshyam Maharaj in the mandir, Mahant Swami Maharaj said, "Yesterday the plume was here (on Thakorji's stomach); today it has come up (onto his head)." Then, pointing to Ghanshyam Maharaj's handkerchief, he said, "The colour of the handkerchief is very fine. Perfectly matching."
Just as a bee is immersed in a bowl of honey, Swamishri becomes absorbed in the murti. His art of darshan is truly worth imitating.

Today, after completing the morning puja, when Mahant Swami Maharaj came in front of the sadhus' ashram, a devotee standing there, wishing to be remembered and with humour, said, "Swami! I am Shrikrishna Pandya. I have received the President's award for best teacher. I have been principal of our school. For years I have served as a coordinator in satsang activities. These are all my achievements. Now tell us your achievements: who are you?"
"Servant," Swamishri said, as quick as popcorn popping.
"In every colour he wishes to be in the form of a servant, like a well of nectar water..." That is Swamishri's life principle.

Udayanbhai Patel, a devotee of Ahmedabad, had for the last 7 or 8 years developed many problems in his legs. To get over them he had consulted very reputable doctors in Ahmedabad and had taken all the medicines and treatments as they advised, but the result was nil.

As his health worsened further from 4 October 2017, he had a second MRI test done. It was found that there was a large tumour of 2 by 2 inches, weighing about 500 grams, right on his spinal cord. So the spine specialist advised an immediate operation, but one full of risk and with very little chance of success. He had said, "The operation will have to be done, but there is no guarantee in this, because in such operations the patient mostly loses bowel and bladder control. Or paralysis may set in, problems in the eyes, deafness in the ears, numbness of the body, many such problems are possible." Such a condition occurs in one in three million. Other doctors too were of the same opinion.
On the night of 11 October 2017 both his legs went numb, and falling at home from the walking frame he used for support, he fractured both legs.

On 12 October 2017 this situation was told to Mahant Swami Maharaj. Swamishri gave his blessings: "You have been making efforts for the last five days, but now since the operation is absolutely necessary, have it done. Swamibapa's grace and blessings, and Maharaj and Swami, will join in and be present. We will pray."
That same night Pramukh Swami Maharaj gave him darshan, passed his hand over his whole back and said, "Mahant Swami's blessings are there and he will protect you."

On 13 October 2017, spine specialist Dr Hiteshbhai Modi undertook this operation. The operation was a challenge, but he was amazed that as soon as he opened it, the tumour became clearly visible at once, as if it had been waiting, ready. After it was removed, all the surrounding nerves settled into place by themselves. Because of this, the operation that was to last eight hours was completed in just two and a half hours with complete success. Not only that, there was not a single side effect. Moreover, as of today he has resumed all his work.

"Through your glory, the lame climb the mountain..." Dr Hiteshbhai experienced this. So today he had come for Swamishri's darshan. He had already developed a feeling of reverence for Swamishri, but Swamishri's darshan increased that feeling. Coming out, he exclaimed, "There is great radiance in Swamishri."
Mahant Swami Maharaj took his walk while giving darshan to sadhus and devotees. When the walk was finished, the sadhus asked, "What do you think about while walking?"
Swamishri said, "This devotee is divine... this devotee is divine... this devotee is divine... like that, all are divine. And the other thought is of Maharaj and Swami."
The repetition that we should be doing for Swamishri, "Swamishri is divine... Swamishri is divine...", he does for us. What a great thing that is?!
